topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Finding my college application essay published as an example was a revelation. There it was, my words, my thoughts, laid out for others to see, dissect, perhaps even emulate. It was as if the very essence of my ambition, the crystallization of months of introspection and refinement, had been given a life of its own. The essay, once just a requirement, a task to complete, now stood as a testament to something more. It was no longer just personal; it was a bridge, connecting my efforts to the aspirations of others. This unexpected turn of events didn’t just affirm the value of my work; it expanded it, giving it a purpose I hadn’t dared to imagine.
